dailyAutoPost.label: Publish a case automatically every day
dailyAutoPost.helpText: Off by default. Turn this on only in a subreddit with live players - an empty subreddit taking one bot post a day is the pattern Reddit's antispam acts on. If a published case is filtered, the app stops the schedule by itself and sends modmail.

dailyPostHourUtc.label: Hour (UTC) to publish the daily case
dailyPostHourUtc.helpText: 0-23. The schedule is checked every hour and publishes once, on this hour.
